text: Sorry for the wait. 1) Only-good-bets: that rule shipped in v1.0.133 (the list shows only bet types rated 2+ stars at Novig, and it is still ON in the engine settings). The hard block for by-hand bets on proven losers (HB1) is NOT built yet, so the Bet sheet still only warns. If you saw a losing bet in a list, it is probably an older app version or a stale list. Tell me which bet and I'll trace it. HB1 is next. 2) Few bids: 9 bids are resting right now ($7.97). The engine wallet is about $0.01, so it has almost nothing to post with, and that is the main limit. Fund the engine subaccount and bids will fill out.
